name: Mailmodo
description_en:
Mailmodo combines email campaigns, interactive AMP/HTML content and automated journeys. A journey can react to list membership, an application event or an email-form submission, then send a message or update contact information. Vendor AI tools propose templates and journey structures; their output still needs operational review.

Its distinctive evaluation question is whether the recipient can complete the intended interaction in their actual email client, and whether the next journey step interprets that interaction correctly. This profile connects fallback design, event data, journey controls and billing limits using documentation rather than a live campaign.
description_zh:
Mailmodo 结合邮件活动、交互式 AMP／HTML 内容及自动化路径。路径可响应列表成员身份、应用事件或邮件表单提交，再发送消息或更新联系人。厂商 AI 工具提供模板及路径结构建议，但输出仍需运行层面的检查。

其关键评估问题是：收件人能否在实际邮箱客户端完成预期互动，以及后续步骤是否正确解读该互动。本文通过文档连接回退设计、事件数据、路径控制和计费限制，未运行真实活动。

review_notes: Original English and corresponding Chinese research draft. Vendor statements describe documented behavior, not independently measured quality.
Existing third-party source is discovery-only and superseded. Unknown UI languages, regional availability and licensing remain unknown.
All publication and alternative-relationship states remain unapproved.

sections.title_en: A form response can become a journey input
sections.title_zh: 表单回应可成为路径输入
sections.en:
The journey overview documents email-form submission as an entry event, along with application events, list changes and API/webhook triggers. For an illustrative workshop campaign, a completed form can lead into a confirmation and a later reminder. A missing open is not the same observation as a missing form submission.

The components guide separates actions, waits and conditions. A Submitted branch answers a different question from Clicked. Define which response is the actual registration signal before building downstream follow-ups or updating a contact property.
sections.zh:
路径概览将邮件表单提交列为入口事件，此外还有应用事件、列表变化及 API／Webhook 触发。例如工作坊活动，表单完成后可进入确认及后续提醒；没有打开与没有提交表单不是同一观察。

组件指南区分动作、等待及条件。Submitted 分支与 Clicked 回答不同问题。构建后续跟进或更新联系人属性前，应先明确哪个回应才代表实际报名。

sections.title_en: Design the interaction twice where necessary
sections.title_zh: 必要时分别设计两种互动路径
sections.en:
The fallback guide asks authors to edit the HTML version whenever an AMP element is added. AMP requires sender approval and a compatible client/settings environment; the troubleshooting guide also lists a 200 kB size ceiling and organization mailbox restrictions.

For the workshop, review how a recipient can register when the in-email form is absent. Supply a usable fallback route and test its destination and confirmation behavior. Current pricing describes CSS interactivity for some clients as well, but that is not proof of identical AMP behavior. This research did not establish a universal supported-client matrix.
sections.zh:
回退指南要求每添加一个 AMP 元素，就编辑 HTML 版本。AMP 需要发送者审批及兼容的客户端／设置环境；故障指南还列出 200 kB 大小上限与组织邮箱限制。

工作坊示例中，应检查邮件内表单缺席时如何报名。需提供可用回退路径并测试目标页及确认行为。当前价格页还描述部分客户端的 CSS 互动，但不能证明与 AMP 行为相同。本文未确认统一的客户端支持矩阵。

sections.title_en: Map event details before sending a personalized confirmation
sections.title_zh: 个性化确认前先映射事件信息
sections.en:
The Send Campaign action configures a template, subject, preheader, sender and reply-to address. When the content contains personalization parameters, a mapping popup assigns their values. For an event-triggered journey, the guide specifically requires choosing the correct event and mapping event properties.

A workshop title or session time is event context; a contact’s name is audience data. Keep those meanings explicit and inspect a representative confirmation before launch. The guide does not establish a universal fallback value or retry guarantee for every missing event field, so those cases need a controlled test.
sections.zh:
Send Campaign 动作配置模板、主题、预览文本、发送者及回复地址。内容包含个性化参数时，通过映射弹窗赋值；事件触发路径需选择正确事件并映射其属性。

工作坊名称或场次时间属于事件上下文，联系人姓名属于受众数据。应明确区分，并在上线前检查代表性确认。指南未规定所有缺失事件字段的统一默认值或重试保证，这些情况需受控测试。

sections.title_en: Draft changes and test actions have consequences
sections.title_zh: 草稿修改与测试动作都有实际含义
sections.en:
The building guide requires connected, configured nodes before publication and a delay between consecutive Send Campaign blocks. Its test function sends the configured campaigns to the supplied address and warns against using customer addresses. Treat that as an operation with real effects, not a harmless visual preview.

The overview says a saved journey’s trigger type cannot simply be changed because later mappings depend on it; duplication is the documented route. Review the copy’s entry rules and messaging before publishing so the original and copy do not unintentionally address the same cohort.
sections.zh:
构建指南要求发布前连接并配置所有节点，并在连续 Send Campaign 之间加入等待。测试功能会向提供的地址发送已配置活动，且提示不要用客户地址。因此它是有实际影响的操作，不能当作无害的视觉预览。

概览说明，保存后的触发器类型不能直接改变，因为后续映射依赖它；文档建议复制后改入口。发布副本前需检查进入规则及消息，避免原版与副本意外触达同一群体。

sections.title_en: Inspect the active-contact choice when pausing
sections.title_zh: 暂停时检查现有联系人的处理选项
sections.en:
The step-by-step guide summarizes Pause as stopping new entry while current contacts finish. The dashboard guide instead documents a choice: hold current contacts at their stage or let them continue. It says cancellation cannot resume, but a later sentence incorrectly says a paused journey cannot resume despite its own Resume instructions.

Because these pages disagree, inspect the actual dialog and select the required treatment deliberately. For a temporary correction, confirm resumption behavior with a small test cohort. Do not assume that Pause freezes everyone or that Cancel is reversible.
sections.zh:
逐步指南把 Pause 概括为阻止新人、现有人完成；仪表盘指南则明确可选择让现有人停在当前阶段或继续。该指南称取消后不能恢复，但后面一句又称暂停后不能恢复，与其 Resume 说明自相矛盾。

由于页面不一致，需检查实际弹窗并明确选择处理方式。临时修正时，应使用小测试群体确认恢复行为。不能假设 Pause 会冻结所有人，也不能假设 Cancel 可逆。

sections.title_en: Read submission rates with their stated denominator
sections.title_zh: 按文档分母解读提交率
sections.en:
The dashboard defines submission rate as submissions divided by opens, while delivery rate uses delivered divided by sent. Failed contacts can include bounces, unsubscribes and exhausted limits. Its contact log covers the last 100 completed/failed contacts, rather than claiming a complete indefinite history.

For the workshop, compare actual registrations with an external registration record as well as email reporting. A submission/open ratio does not represent all eligible invitees. Define the observation period and reconcile failed contacts before interpreting an AI-generated analysis as a business outcome.
sections.zh:
仪表盘将提交率定义为提交数除以打开数，投递率为已投递除以已发送。失败联系人可能包括退信、退订及额度耗尽；联系人日志只覆盖最近 100 位完成／失败的人，并未声称无限期完整历史。

工作坊示例中，除邮件报告外，还应与外部报名记录核对。提交／打开的比值不代表所有符合资格的受邀者。解读 AI 分析为业务结果前，需明确观察期并核对失败联系人。

sections.title_en: Budget active journeys as well as email credits
sections.title_zh: 除发送积分外也核算活跃路径
sections.en:
At the displayed 500-contact annual selection, Lite shows $149/month, 2,000 sending credits and one active journey; Pro shows $199/month, 3,000 credits and ten journeys. Both show 500 active contacts per journey, with different API rates and seats. Max is quoted. The lower competitor-comparison table displays inconsistent amounts, so no normalized price is inferred.

Mailmodo merits evaluation when in-email interactions justify separate fallback design, sender approval and journey monitoring. A simple static newsletter may not need those operations. Confirm the current quote, sending-credit period and overage rules; a free signup call to action alone does not establish a permanent free sending plan.
sections.zh:
当前所显示的 500 人年付选项中，Lite 为每月等值 $149、2,000 发送积分及一个活跃路径；Pro 为 $199、3,000 积分及十个路径。两者均列每路径 500 位活跃联系人，API 速率及席位不同；Max 询价。下方竞品比较表显示不一致金额，因此不推导标准化价格。

邮件内互动值得投入独立回退设计、发送者审批及路径监控时，可评估 Mailmodo。简单静态简报可能无需这些工作。需确认当前报价、积分周期及超额规则；免费注册按钮本身不能证明永久免费发送套餐。

seo.title_en: Mailmodo: AMP Fallback, Event Journeys, Pause Controls and Costs
seo.title_zh: Mailmodo：AMP 回退、事件路径、暂停控制及费用
seo.description_en: Understand Mailmodo interactive email dependencies, personalization mapping, real test sends and documented pricing/control conflicts.
seo.description_zh: 了解 Mailmodo 交互邮件依赖、个性化映射、真实测试发送，以及文档价格／控制冲突。
seo.primary_intent: Evaluate Mailmodo interactive email journeys with fallback and operating requirements.
seo.query_basis: Editorial intent; no search volume, ranking or AI visibility measured.

research_gaps.en: Pricing cards conflict with a lower comparison table; exact quote, credit reset period, overage and permanent-free entitlement remain unverified.
research_gaps.zh: 价格卡片与下方比较表冲突；准确报价、积分重置周期、超额及永久免费权限仍未核实。

research_gaps.en: Pause/cancel documentation is internally inconsistent. No account, AMP client, journey, API or send was tested. UI languages, regional availability, source license and self-hosting rights remain unverified.
research_gaps.zh: 暂停／取消文档内部不一致。未测试账户、AMP 客户端、路径、API 或发送。界面语言、地区可用性、源码许可及自托管权利仍未核实。
